{"action": "write", "path": "clean_contacts.py", "content": "import csv

with open("contacts.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

best = {}
for row in rows:
    email = row["email"].strip().lower()
    created = row["created"].strip()
    name = row["name"]
    if email not in best or created < best[email][2]:
        best[email] = (name, email, created)

out = sorted(best.values(), key=lambda r: (r[2], r[1]))

with open("clean.csv", "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["name", "email", "created"])
    w.writerows(out)
"}
